item.tib: bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pa'i bka' 'bum las dge sdig rnam par 'byed pa dmyal ba'i mthong snang
item.coloph: ces pa'i dmyal snang mang po dngos su byung yang rang rgyud sbyang ba'i man ngag ma gtogs gzhan la bskul ba'i gdams pa bstan rgyu gtan nas ma bsam kyang/ rigs ldan mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang / mchog sprul g.yung drung nyi ma gnyis kyi dge bskul phyir du las can la blta ba'i me long dmyal snang de phab dgos kyi nan tan dang ma zad kho bo'i rgyus mchog sprul sku grags pa nas kyang dngos rdzas kyi mtshams sbyar te 'gro ba la skyo shas nges 'byung dge bskul phyir/ khyung dbon nyi ma rgyal mtshan drang srong tshul khrims mchog rgyal/ dpe bstan gyi dmyal snang de phab dgos gsung nan gnang ba dang / lhag par ye shes dgon gyi dge bshes dbang rgyal/ rtogs ldan bsod nams tshe dbang / bla grwa yongs rdzogs kyi dmyal snang dge bskul mtshams rtsa bzhag pa dang*/ nye bar g.yung drung ye shes/ g.yung drung dpal ldan/ bskal bzang bstan rgyal sogs dang mang po'i bskul ngor ldog ma nus pa/ bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas dmyal snang ma bcos pa rang dgon g.yung drung mthong smon gling du bris pas/ dge des mkha' khyab sems can thams cad bde chen zhing du dbugs 'byin thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
